title: Adult Mouse Testis Cell Dissociation on Ice
author: Robert Mahoney
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.smkec4w

steps.title: Mince testis tissue on ice
steps.instruction: Mince adult mouse testis tissue with a sterile razor blade on a petri dish kept on ice.

steps.title: Add tissue to enzyme solution
steps.instruction: Transfer 25 mg of the minced testis tissue into 1 mL enzyme solution in a 1.5 mL tube kept on ice.

steps.title: Initial trituration on ice
steps.instruction: While the tube remains on ice, triturate the suspension 10 times, performing a pipette up‑and‑down every two minutes for a total of 10 minutes, using a P1000 pipette set to 700 µL.

steps.title: Transfer to C‑tube
steps.instruction: After the 10‑minute incubation, transfer the entire contents to a Miltenyi C‑tube.

steps.title: Run brain_03 program
steps.instruction: Place the C‑tube in a 4 °C cold room and run the Miltenyi program “brain_03” twice.

steps.title: Quick spin to collect cells
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the C‑tube (quick spin) to bring all liquid and cells to the bottom.

steps.title: Second trituration on ice
steps.instruction: Continue trituration on ice in the C‑tube 10 times, adding a pipette action every two minutes for an additional 12 minutes (total incubation time 25 minutes).

steps.title: Filter through 30 µm mesh
steps.instruction: After the 25‑minute total incubation, process the suspension through a 30 µm filter in a sterile 15 mL conical tube kept on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add the digest mix to the filter.
Rinse the filter with 3 mL ice‑cold 10 % FBS/PBS.

steps.title: First spin and wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtered suspension at 500 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 10 mL ice‑cold 0.04 % BSA/PBS.

steps.title: Second spin and concentrate
steps.instruction: Spin again at 500 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the final pellet in 200 µL ice‑cold 0.04 % BSA/PBS.

steps.title: Count and adjust concentration
steps.instruction: Count cells using a hemocytometer with trypan blue, then adjust the suspension to 1,000 cells/µL for Chromium or 100 cells/µL for Drop‑seq as needed.
